### Create Agent Action
POST /voice-ai/actions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/voice-ai/actions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/voice-ai/create-action | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/voice-ai/create-action.md

Create a new action for a voice AI agent. Actions define specific behaviors and capabilities for the agent during calls.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: voice-ai-agent-goals.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateSingleActionDTO:
- agentId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Agent ID to attach the action to
- locationId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012") - Location ID
- actionType* string (enum: CALL_TRANSFER | DATA_EXTRACTION | IN_CALL_DATA_EXTRACTION | WORKFLOW_TRIGGER | SMS | APPOINTMENT_BOOKING | CUSTOM_ACTION | KNOWLEDGE_BASE; e.g. "CALL_TRANSFER") - Type of action
- name* string (e.g. "Transfer to Manager") - Human-readable name for this action
- actionParameters* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action parameters - structure varies by actionType
  - option 1 CallTransferActionParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When the caller asks to speak to a manager") - When to trigger this action during the call
    - transferToType* string (enum: number; e.g. "number") - Type of transfer destination (currently only "number" is supported)
    - transferToValue* string (e.g. "+12345678901") - Phone number to transfer to. Must start with +, include country code, contain only numbers, and be 11-16 characters long (e.g., +12345678901).
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "Let me transfer you to a manager right away") - Message to tell the caller before transferring
    - hearWhisperMessage boolean - Whether to play whisper message to the receiving party
  - option 2 DataExtractionActionParameters: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - ID of the contact field to be updated with the extracted data
    - description* string (e.g. "Caller's phone number") - Description of what data to extract
    - examples* string[] (e.g. ["+1234567890","+9876543210"]) - Example values to help Agent understand the expected format. At least one example is required, maximum 5 examples allowed.
    - overwriteExistingValue boolean (default: false) - Whether to overwrite existing field value if already set, default is false
  - option 3 InCallDataExtractionActionParameters: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - ID of the contact field to be updated with the extracted data
    - description* string (e.g. "Caller's phone number") - Description of what data to extract
    - examples* string[] (e.g. ["+1234567890","+9876543210"]) - Example values to help Agent understand the expected format. At least one example is required, maximum 5 examples allowed.
    - overwriteExistingValue boolean (default: false) - Whether to overwrite existing field value if already set, default is false
  - option 4 WorkflowTriggerParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller requests a quote") - When to trigger this workflow
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "Let me start that process for you") - Message to tell the caller
    - workflowId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Workflow ID to trigger
  - option 5 SMSParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller asks for booking confirmation") - When to send the SMS
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "I'll send you a confirmation text") - Message to tell the caller
    - messageBody* string (e.g. "Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 2 PM") - SMS message content to send
  - option 6 AppointmentBookingActionParameters: object
    - calendarId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Calendar ID to book appointments in
    - daysOfOfferingDates* number (e.g. 3) - Number of days ahead to offer booking dates
    - slotsPerDay* number (e.g. 3) - Number of available slots per day
    - hoursBetweenSlots* number (e.g. 1) - Hours between available slots
  - option 7 CustomActionParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller provides order number") - When to call the custom API
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "Let me check that order status") - Message to tell the caller

      - url* string (e.g. "https://api.example.com/orders") - API endpoint URL

      - headers object[] - HTTP headers to include
        - key* string (e.g. "id") - HTTP header name
        - value* string (e.g. "1234567890") - HTTP header value
      - parameters object[] - API parameters to send
        - name* string (e.g. "orderId") - Parameter name
        - description string (e.g. "Order ID to look up") - Parameter description

        - example string (e.g. "ORD-12345") - Example parameter value
    - selectedPaths string[] (e.g. ["data.orderId","status"]) - Selected response paths to extract from API response. Required: at least 1 value if the method is GET. Should be empty if the method is POST.
  - option 8 KnowledgeBaseParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller asks about pricing") - When to query the knowledge base
    - knowledgeBaseId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Knowledge base ID to query

### Create Agent
POST /voice-ai/agents
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/voice-ai/agents
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/voice-ai/create-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/voice-ai/create-agent.md

Create a new voice AI agent configuration and settings

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: voice-ai-agents.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) AgentCreationRequestDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "LOC123456789ABCDEF") - Unique identifier for the location where this agent will operate
- agentName string (minLength: 1; maxLength: 40; e.g. "Customer Support Agent") - Display name for the voice AI agent, between 1-40 characters. Default: "My Agent {random 3 digit number}"
- businessName string (minLength: 1; e.g. "Acme Corporation") - Name of the business this agent represents. Default: Uses location name
- welcomeMessage string (minLength: 1; maxLength: 190; e.g. "Hello! Thank you for calling Acme Corporation. How can I assist you today?") - Initial greeting spoken when the agent answers calls. Default: Auto generated
- agentPrompt string (e.g. "You are a helpful customer service representative. Always be polite and professional.") - Custom instructions defining the agent's behavior and personality. Default: Basic prompt generated automatically
- voiceId string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Identifier for the speech synthesis voice from available voice options. Default: Auto generated
- language string (enum: en-US | pt-BR | es | fr | de | it | nl-NL | multi; e.g. "en-US") - Language code for the agent's speech and understanding. Default: "en-US"
- patienceLevel string (enum: low | medium | high; e.g. "low") - Tolerance level for caller response delays. Default: "high"
- maxCallDuration number (min: 180; max: 900; e.g. 600) - Maximum call duration in seconds, between 180-900 (3-15 minutes). Default: 300 seconds (5 minutes)
- sendUserIdleReminders boolean - Enables automatic reminders when callers are silent. Default: true
- reminderAfterIdleTimeSeconds number (min: 1; max: 20; e.g. 5) - Seconds to wait before sending idle reminders, between 1-20. Default: 8 seconds
- inboundNumber string (e.g. "+1234567890") - Phone number for receiving inbound calls to this agent. Default: null
- numberPoolId string (e.g. "pool_507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Identifier for the number pool managing phone number allocation. Default: null
- callEndWorkflowIds string[] (maxItems: 10; e.g. ["wf_507f1f77bcf86cd799439011","wf_507f1f77bcf86cd799439012"]) - Array of workflow IDs to trigger automatically when calls end. Default: []
- sendPostCallNotificationTo object - Configuration for post-call email notifications to various recipients. Default: []
  - admins* boolean - Enables post-call notifications to all admin users in the location. Default: true
  - allUsers* boolean - Enables post-call notifications to all users in the location. Default: false
  - contactAssignedUser* boolean - Enables post-call notifications to the user assigned to the contact. Default: false
  - specificUsers* string[] (e.g. ["user_507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"]) - Array of specific user IDs to receive post-call notifications. Default: []
  - customEmails* string[] (e.g. ["manager@company.com"]) - Array of custom email addresses to receive post-call notifications. Default: []
- agentWorkingHours object[] - Time intervals defining when the agent accepts calls, organized by day of week. Default: [] (available 24/7)
  - dayOfTheWeek* number (enum: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7; e.g. 1) - Day of the week for this working hours configuration (Monday=1 to Sunday=7)
  - intervals* object[] - Array of time intervals when the agent is available on this day
    - startHour* number (min: 0; max: 23; e.g. 9) - Starting hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - endHour* number (min: 0; max: 23; e.g. 17) - Ending hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - startMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59; e.g. 0) - Starting minute of the working interval (0-59)
    - endMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59; e.g. 30) - Ending minute of the working interval (0-59)
- timezone string (pattern: ^[A-Za-z_]+/[A-Za-z_]+$; e.g. "America/New_York") - IANA timezone identifier affecting working hours and scheduling. Default: Location timezone
- isAgentAsBackupDisabled boolean - Prevents this agent from being used as a fallback option. Default: false (Available as backup agent)
- translation object - Language translation settings including enablement flag and target language code. Rules: (1) translation.enabled can only be true if the agent's language is not en-US; (2) when enabled, translation.language must be either the agent's language or en-US; (3) when enabled, translation.language is required.
  - enabled* boolean - Enables language translation for agent conversations. Default: false
  - language string (e.g. "es") - Target language code for translation (e.g., "es" for Spanish, "fr" for French).

Response 201 (Agent created successfully) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier for the created agent
- locationId* string - Unique identifier for the location where this agent operates
- agentName* string - Display name of the voice AI agent
- businessName* string - Name of the business this agent represents
- welcomeMessage* string - Greeting message spoken when the agent answers calls
- agentPrompt* string - Custom instructions defining the agent's behavior
- voiceId* string - Identifier for the speech synthesis voice being used
- language* string - Language code for the agent's speech and understanding
- patienceLevel* string - Current tolerance level for caller response delays
- maxCallDuration* number (min: 180; max: 900) - Maximum call duration in seconds, between 180-900
- sendUserIdleReminders* boolean - Indicates whether automatic idle reminders are enabled
- reminderAfterIdleTimeSeconds* number (min: 1; max: 20) - Seconds to wait before sending idle reminders, between 1-20
- inboundNumber string - Phone number for receiving inbound calls
- numberPoolId string - Identifier for the number pool managing this agent's phone allocation
- callEndWorkflowIds string[] - Array of workflow IDs triggered automatically when calls end
- sendPostCallNotificationTo object - Current post-call notification settings including recipient configuration
  - admins boolean - Send notifications to admins
  - allUsers boolean - Send notifications to all users
  - contactAssignedUser boolean - Send notifications to contact assigned user
  - specificUsers string[] - Specific user IDs to notify
  - customEmails string[] - Custom email addresses to notify
- agentWorkingHours object[] - Time intervals when the agent accepts calls, organized by day of week
  - dayOfTheWeek* number (enum: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7) - Day of the week for this working hours configuration (Monday=1 to Sunday=7)
  - intervals* object[] - Array of time intervals when the agent is available on this day
    - startHour* number (min: 0; max: 23) - Starting hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - endHour* number (min: 0; max: 23) - Ending hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - startMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59) - Starting minute of the working interval (0-59)
    - endMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59) - Ending minute of the working interval (0-59)
- timezone* string - IANA timezone identifier for working hours and scheduling
- isAgentAsBackupDisabled* boolean - Indicates whether this agent is excluded from backup scenarios
- translation object - Current language translation settings including enablement status and target language
  - enabled boolean - Whether translation is enabled
  - language string - Translation language code

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

Returns call logs for Voice AI agents scoped to a location. Supports filtering by agent, contact, call type, action types, and date range (interpreted in the provided IANA timezone). Also supports sorting and 1-based pagination.

- callType string (enum: LIVE | TRIAL) - Call type filter.
- startDate number (e.g. 1679308800000) - Start date filter (Unix timestamp). Must be less than endDate. Both startDate and endDate must be provided together.
- endDate number (e.g. 1679395199000) - End date filter (Unix timestamp). Must be greater than startDate. Both startDate and endDate must be provided together.

### Patch Agent
PATCH /voice-ai/agents/{agentId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/voice-ai/agents/{agentId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/voice-ai/patch-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/voice-ai/patch-agent.md

Partially update an existing voice AI agent

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: voice-ai-agents.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Unique agent identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "LOC123456789ABCDEF") - Location ID

Request body (required) (application/json) PatchAgentDTO:
- agentName string (minLength: 1; maxLength: 40; e.g. "Customer Support Agent") - Display name for the voice AI agent, between 1-40 characters. Default: "My Agent {random 3 digit number}"
- businessName string (minLength: 1; e.g. "Acme Corporation") - Name of the business this agent represents. Default: Uses location name
- welcomeMessage string (minLength: 1; maxLength: 190; e.g. "Hello! Thank you for calling Acme Corporation. How can I assist you today?") - Initial greeting spoken when the agent answers calls. Default: Auto generated
- agentPrompt string (e.g. "You are a helpful customer service representative. Always be polite and professional.") - Custom instructions defining the agent's behavior and personality. Default: Basic prompt generated automatically
- voiceId string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Identifier for the speech synthesis voice from available voice options. Default: Auto generated
- language string (enum: en-US | pt-BR | es | fr | de | it | nl-NL | multi; e.g. "en-US") - Language code for the agent's speech and understanding. Default: "en-US"
- patienceLevel string (enum: low | medium | high; e.g. "low") - Tolerance level for caller response delays. Default: "high"
- maxCallDuration number (min: 180; max: 900; e.g. 600) - Maximum call duration in seconds, between 180-900 (3-15 minutes). Default: 300 seconds (5 minutes)
- sendUserIdleReminders boolean - Enables automatic reminders when callers are silent. Default: true
- reminderAfterIdleTimeSeconds number (min: 1; max: 20; e.g. 5) - Seconds to wait before sending idle reminders, between 1-20. Default: 8 seconds
- inboundNumber string (e.g. "+1234567890") - Phone number for receiving inbound calls to this agent. Default: null
- numberPoolId string (e.g. "pool_507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Identifier for the number pool managing phone number allocation. Default: null
- callEndWorkflowIds string[] (maxItems: 10; e.g. ["wf_507f1f77bcf86cd799439011","wf_507f1f77bcf86cd799439012"]) - Array of workflow IDs to trigger automatically when calls end. Default: []
- sendPostCallNotificationTo object - Configuration for post-call email notifications to various recipients. Default: []
  - admins* boolean - Enables post-call notifications to all admin users in the location. Default: true
  - allUsers* boolean - Enables post-call notifications to all users in the location. Default: false
  - contactAssignedUser* boolean - Enables post-call notifications to the user assigned to the contact. Default: false
  - specificUsers* string[] (e.g. ["user_507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"]) - Array of specific user IDs to receive post-call notifications. Default: []
  - customEmails* string[] (e.g. ["manager@company.com"]) - Array of custom email addresses to receive post-call notifications. Default: []
- agentWorkingHours object[] - Time intervals defining when the agent accepts calls, organized by day of week. Default: [] (available 24/7)
  - dayOfTheWeek* number (enum: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7; e.g. 1) - Day of the week for this working hours configuration (Monday=1 to Sunday=7)
  - intervals* object[] - Array of time intervals when the agent is available on this day
    - startHour* number (min: 0; max: 23; e.g. 9) - Starting hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - endHour* number (min: 0; max: 23; e.g. 17) - Ending hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - startMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59; e.g. 0) - Starting minute of the working interval (0-59)
    - endMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59; e.g. 30) - Ending minute of the working interval (0-59)
- timezone string (pattern: ^[A-Za-z_]+/[A-Za-z_]+$; e.g. "America/New_York") - IANA timezone identifier affecting working hours and scheduling. Default: Location timezone
- isAgentAsBackupDisabled boolean - Prevents this agent from being used as a fallback option. Default: false (Available as backup agent)
- translation object - Language translation settings including enablement flag and target language code. Rules: (1) translation.enabled can only be true if the agent's language is not en-US; (2) when enabled, translation.language must be either the agent's language or en-US; (3) when enabled, translation.language is required.
  - enabled* boolean - Enables language translation for agent conversations. Default: false
  - language string (e.g. "es") - Target language code for translation (e.g., "es" for Spanish, "fr" for French).

Response 200 (Agent updated successfully) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier for the created agent
- locationId* string - Unique identifier for the location where this agent operates
- agentName* string - Display name of the voice AI agent
- businessName* string - Name of the business this agent represents
- welcomeMessage* string - Greeting message spoken when the agent answers calls
- agentPrompt* string - Custom instructions defining the agent's behavior
- voiceId* string - Identifier for the speech synthesis voice being used
- language* string - Language code for the agent's speech and understanding
- patienceLevel* string - Current tolerance level for caller response delays
- maxCallDuration* number (min: 180; max: 900) - Maximum call duration in seconds, between 180-900
- sendUserIdleReminders* boolean - Indicates whether automatic idle reminders are enabled
- reminderAfterIdleTimeSeconds* number (min: 1; max: 20) - Seconds to wait before sending idle reminders, between 1-20
- inboundNumber string - Phone number for receiving inbound calls
- numberPoolId string - Identifier for the number pool managing this agent's phone allocation
- callEndWorkflowIds string[] - Array of workflow IDs triggered automatically when calls end
- sendPostCallNotificationTo object - Current post-call notification settings including recipient configuration
  - admins boolean - Send notifications to admins
  - allUsers boolean - Send notifications to all users
  - contactAssignedUser boolean - Send notifications to contact assigned user
  - specificUsers string[] - Specific user IDs to notify
  - customEmails string[] - Custom email addresses to notify
- agentWorkingHours object[] - Time intervals when the agent accepts calls, organized by day of week
  - dayOfTheWeek* number (enum: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7) - Day of the week for this working hours configuration (Monday=1 to Sunday=7)
  - intervals* object[] - Array of time intervals when the agent is available on this day
    - startHour* number (min: 0; max: 23) - Starting hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - endHour* number (min: 0; max: 23) - Ending hour of the working interval in 24-hour format (0-23)
    - startMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59) - Starting minute of the working interval (0-59)
    - endMinute* number (min: 0; max: 59) - Ending minute of the working interval (0-59)
- timezone* string - IANA timezone identifier for working hours and scheduling
- isAgentAsBackupDisabled* boolean - Indicates whether this agent is excluded from backup scenarios
- translation object - Current language translation settings including enablement status and target language
  - enabled boolean - Whether translation is enabled
  - language string - Translation language code

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

Path parameters:
- actionId* string - Unique identifier for the action

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateSingleActionDTO:
- agentId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Agent ID to attach the action to
- locationId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012") - Location ID
- actionType* string (enum: CALL_TRANSFER | DATA_EXTRACTION | IN_CALL_DATA_EXTRACTION | WORKFLOW_TRIGGER | SMS | APPOINTMENT_BOOKING | CUSTOM_ACTION | KNOWLEDGE_BASE; e.g. "CALL_TRANSFER") - Type of action
- name* string (e.g. "Transfer to Manager") - Human-readable name for this action
- actionParameters* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action parameters - structure varies by actionType
  - option 1 CallTransferActionParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When the caller asks to speak to a manager") - When to trigger this action during the call
    - transferToType* string (enum: number; e.g. "number") - Type of transfer destination (currently only "number" is supported)
    - transferToValue* string (e.g. "+12345678901") - Phone number to transfer to. Must start with +, include country code, contain only numbers, and be 11-16 characters long (e.g., +12345678901).
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "Let me transfer you to a manager right away") - Message to tell the caller before transferring
    - hearWhisperMessage boolean - Whether to play whisper message to the receiving party
  - option 2 DataExtractionActionParameters: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - ID of the contact field to be updated with the extracted data
    - description* string (e.g. "Caller's phone number") - Description of what data to extract
    - examples* string[] (e.g. ["+1234567890","+9876543210"]) - Example values to help Agent understand the expected format. At least one example is required, maximum 5 examples allowed.
    - overwriteExistingValue boolean (default: false) - Whether to overwrite existing field value if already set, default is false
  - option 3 InCallDataExtractionActionParameters: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - ID of the contact field to be updated with the extracted data
    - description* string (e.g. "Caller's phone number") - Description of what data to extract
    - examples* string[] (e.g. ["+1234567890","+9876543210"]) - Example values to help Agent understand the expected format. At least one example is required, maximum 5 examples allowed.
    - overwriteExistingValue boolean (default: false) - Whether to overwrite existing field value if already set, default is false
  - option 4 WorkflowTriggerParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller requests a quote") - When to trigger this workflow
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "Let me start that process for you") - Message to tell the caller
    - workflowId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Workflow ID to trigger
  - option 5 SMSParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller asks for booking confirmation") - When to send the SMS
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "I'll send you a confirmation text") - Message to tell the caller
    - messageBody* string (e.g. "Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 2 PM") - SMS message content to send
  - option 6 AppointmentBookingActionParameters: object
    - calendarId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Calendar ID to book appointments in
    - daysOfOfferingDates* number (e.g. 3) - Number of days ahead to offer booking dates
    - slotsPerDay* number (e.g. 3) - Number of available slots per day
    - hoursBetweenSlots* number (e.g. 1) - Hours between available slots
  - option 7 CustomActionParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller provides order number") - When to call the custom API
    - triggerMessage* string (e.g. "Let me check that order status") - Message to tell the caller
    - apiDetails* object - API endpoint configuration
      - url* string (e.g. "https://api.example.com/orders") - API endpoint URL
      - method* string (enum: POST | GET; e.g. "GET") - HTTP method
      - authenticationRequired boolean - Whether authentication is required
      - authenticationValue string (e.g. "token123") - Authentication token or API key (required if authenticationRequired is true)
      - headers object[] - HTTP headers to include
        - key* string (e.g. "id") - HTTP header name
        - value* string (e.g. "1234567890") - HTTP header value
      - parameters object[] - API parameters to send
        - name* string (e.g. "orderId") - Parameter name
        - description string (e.g. "Order ID to look up") - Parameter description
        - type string (e.g. "string") - Parameter type
        - example string (e.g. "ORD-12345") - Example parameter value
    - selectedPaths string[] (e.g. ["data.orderId","status"]) - Selected response paths to extract from API response. Required: at least 1 value if the method is GET. Should be empty if the method is POST.
  - option 8 KnowledgeBaseParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string (e.g. "When caller asks about pricing") - When to query the knowledge base
    - knowledgeBaseId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Knowledge base ID to query

Response 200 (Action updated successfully) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier for the created action
- actionType* string (enum: CALL_TRANSFER | DATA_EXTRACTION | IN_CALL_DATA_EXTRACTION | WORKFLOW_TRIGGER | SMS | APPOINTMENT_BOOKING | CUSTOM_ACTION | KNOWLEDGE_BASE) - Type of action
- name* string - Human-readable name for this action
- actionParameters* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action parameters - structure varies by actionType
  - option 1 CallTransferActionParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string - When to trigger this action during the call
    - transferToType* string (enum: number) - Type of transfer destination (currently only "number" is supported)
    - transferToValue* string - Phone number to transfer to. Must start with +, include country code, contain only numbers, and be 11-16 characters long (e.g., +12345678901).
    - triggerMessage* string - Message to tell the caller before transferring
    - hearWhisperMessage boolean - Whether to play whisper message to the receiving party
  - option 2 DataExtractionActionParameters: object
    - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field to be updated with the extracted data
    - description* string - Description of what data to extract
    - examples* string[] - Example values to help Agent understand the expected format. At least one example is required, maximum 5 examples allowed.
    - overwriteExistingValue boolean (default: false) - Whether to overwrite existing field value if already set, default is false
  - option 3 InCallDataExtractionActionParameters: object
    - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field to be updated with the extracted data
    - description* string - Description of what data to extract
    - examples* string[] - Example values to help Agent understand the expected format. At least one example is required, maximum 5 examples allowed.
    - overwriteExistingValue boolean (default: false) - Whether to overwrite existing field value if already set, default is false
  - option 4 WorkflowTriggerParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string - When to trigger this workflow
    - triggerMessage* string - Message to tell the caller
    - workflowId* string - Workflow ID to trigger
  - option 5 SMSParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string - When to send the SMS
    - triggerMessage* string - Message to tell the caller
    - messageBody* string - SMS message content to send
  - option 6 AppointmentBookingActionParameters: object
    - calendarId* string - Calendar ID to book appointments in
    - daysOfOfferingDates* number - Number of days ahead to offer booking dates
    - slotsPerDay* number - Number of available slots per day
    - hoursBetweenSlots* number - Hours between available slots
  - option 7 CustomActionParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string - When to call the custom API
    - triggerMessage* string - Message to tell the caller
    - apiDetails* object - API endpoint configuration
      - url* string - API endpoint URL
      - method* string (enum: POST | GET) - HTTP method
      - authenticationRequired boolean - Whether authentication is required
      - authenticationValue string - Authentication token or API key (required if authenticationRequired is true)
      - headers object[] - HTTP headers to include
        - key* string - HTTP header name
        - value* string - HTTP header value
      - parameters object[] - API parameters to send
        - name* string - Parameter name
        - description string - Parameter description
        - type string - Parameter type
        - example string - Example parameter value
    - selectedPaths string[] - Selected response paths to extract from API response. Required: at least 1 value if the method is GET. Should be empty if the method is POST.
  - option 8 KnowledgeBaseParameters: object
    - triggerPrompt* string - When to query the knowledge base
    - knowledgeBaseId* string - Knowledge base ID to query

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
